status_definitions.compatible: Working Underdog-instrumented, hardware-observed interactive slice with stable frames and image witness. Check scope: demo != full game.
status_definitions.in_progress: Candidate, unverified, native-only baseline, or failed current configuration without demonstrated hard impossibility.
status_definitions.not_feasible: Demonstrated infeasible on the specified hardware/driver/backend after bounded performance/correctness evaluation.
